review.reviewer: Codex - bounded geometry, formula, and native appearance review
review.external_analysis_disposition: This task adds a bounded geometric screen. The fingerprinted CAD wall layout and its eight pile-center coordinates were checked. FreeCAD geometry and all structural-analysis inputs/results are unchanged. Vendor-specific reinforcement, full routing, foundation forces, wall stability and other external structural results are outside this acceptance.
review.inherited_issues_disposition: All 269 unassigned components and the original document shell are byte-identical to the accepted base. PedBridge receives one tested index link. The added module has zero native errors; all 67 table/dimension values agree with independent equations. Unrelated inherited journal calculations and overall design currency are not accepted by this bounded review.
